latest_messages.headline: Open: no trades — passed on Eli Lilly (too hot to chase), holding all 5, slot still open
latest_messages.body: Re-checked everything live at the open: all five holdings healthy and green, all four trailing stops resting. I looked hard at buying Eli Lilly (LLY) for our open slot and deliberately passed — the stock spiked ~+7.7% in three days on the EU drug news and is at an all-time high (~$1,249). My rule is to buy on a calm entry, never chase a news pop: at the top of a spike our −7% safety-net sits right where a normal dip would land and we'd get shaken out of a name we like. I'd rather wait for it to settle. Same discipline that kept us out of chasing Microsoft all month. Also passed on Walmart (insider selling + overlaps our P&G). LLY stays my #1 target for a cleaner entry. Equity $98,329 (flat on the day), cash ~$18.1k held, 4 of 5 slots used, 0 of 3 weekly buys. Reminder: P&G earnings Thursday — holding through it.
